owner.responsibility: Browser runtime, platform clients, local privacy/security mediation, and exact Wallet review handoff

walletRegistry.browserAuthorityBoundary: Browser validates and displays the request, then hands it to Wallet. Browser never signs, pays, submits a transaction, widens scopes, or creates an authoritative Product Session.

navigation.phishingBehavior: configured exact-origin match stops navigation and displays a non-guarantee warning

privacy.privateSession: non-persistent or separately isolated platform profile/process where supported
privacy.downloadBoundary: The selected file can remain in the operating-system file system; private downloads must not create a normal YNX Downloads record.
privacy.aiBoundary: AI cannot access private pages, unselected history, Wallet identity, or unrelated tabs.

implementationEvidence.truthBoundary: The tested persistence function is the same function invoked by the macOS WKDownload delegate; full network and NSSavePanel interaction evidence remains open.

localAuditEvents.migrationRequirement: Do not publish these strings as canonical ecosystem events until 26-data-fabric and 29-integration freeze the mapping.

errorSemantics.requiredBehavior: fail-closed with user-safe messages and no internal stack, secret, local path, or provider credential exposure

dependencies.contract: Product registry, Device Challenge, Wallet Approval, Product Session, introspection, expiry and revoke
Provider-neutral Browser assist gateway, streaming/cancel, model/cost/status and audit
Reviewed Search deployment, authorized source inventory, suggestion provenance and outage semantics
Canonical privacy-safe Browser audit event mapping
/browser public route, metadata, downloads and public status links
Protocol freeze, shared Testnet endpoints and cross-product acceptance
Threat policy, signing, SBOM/provenance, hosted artifact and release controls

migration.from: browser-search combined historical handoff and registry candidate
migration.to: Browser-owned contract frozen by 29-integration with central-owner acceptance
migration.compatibility: No dual long-term Wallet registry. Existing v2 candidate remains the only local tuple source until accepted or explicitly migrated.
migration.rollback: Keep Browser fail-closed and disable affected integration surfaces rather than widening callbacks or scopes.
